title: Learning violin on Joe Gabriel's instrument
summary: He secretly learned Home Sweet Home on band leader Joe Gabriel's mandolin and violin; Gabriel approved. No lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Sure. So when I did learn how to play Home Sweet Home, I said, I'm going to let him yell what I can do. Sure enough, when he came in, I said, Joe, get your get-that. He used to play get-that too. He used to play. So I played Home Sweet Home. He said, that's fine. I said, oh, I've got him some now. I was so glad that he didn't call at me about playing on his instrument. So after that, I learned Home Sweet Home on the violin. Then I picked up the violin. See? He said, that's fine. Did you have anybody to help you much at all? No lesson. Nobody. No lesson. See? No, I just couldn't get him going. No. I just couldn't get him going. You know? I went to play the same thing on the violin that I played on the violin. So I kept on until I got the swing of it, you know. Then I played Home Sweet Home on the violin. So he said, that's just fine.
Did you have anybody to help you much at all? Any lessons? No, no. No lesson.
